# J P Extrusiontech (Pvt) Ltd.

> Indian manufacturer and exporter of plastic processing machinery since 1987, based in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India. Also known as JP Extrusiontech, JPEL, or J P Extrusiontech Pvt. Ltd. Website: https://www.jpel.in

J P Extrusiontech (Pvt) Ltd. has been manufacturing and exporting world-class plastic processing machinery for over three decades. Located in Ankleshwar, Gujarat — one of Asia's largest industrial hubs, approximately 360 km from Mumbai — the company operates a 70,000 sq.m. manufacturing facility equipped with advanced machine tools. JP Extrusiontech exports to 44+ countries worldwide.

The JP Group comprises three entities: JP Extrusiontech (Pvt) Ltd., Jaiko Industries, and JP Industries.

## Products

### Tape Extrusion Lines
JP Group's comprehensive range of tape extrusion lines produces high-quality PP/HDPE tapes, available from 150 kg/hr to 900 kg/hr output capacity. Lines of 450–900 kg/hr feature godet diameter of 450 mm with imported screw, barrel, die, and melt pump options. Die widths available: 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1300, 1400, 1500, 1600, 1750, 2200 mm. End applications include woven & leno bags, jumbo bags (FIBCs), tarpaulins, carpet backings, geotextiles, wrapping fabrics, ropes, and twines.
Page: https://jpel.in/TapeExtrusion

### Circular Weaving Machines (Circular Looms)
JP Group offers circular looms for weaving light to heavy weight tubular or flat PP/HDPE fabrics. Models range from 4-shuttle for open mesh (leno weave) packaging fabric for fruits & vegetables, to 6-shuttle for cement, fertilizer, polymer granules, chemicals, grains, animal feed, seeds and husk, and 8-shuttle for wide-width fabric for jumbo bags (FIBCs), tarpaulins, and geo & agro textiles. Machine models include: Jaiko 4, Vega 6, Vega HS, Jaiko 6 LN, Jaiko 608, Jaiko 810, Jaiko 811, Jaiko 812 LF/HF, Jaiko 814 LF/HF, Jaiko 1014 LF/HF, Jaiko 1016 LF/HF.
Page: https://jpel.in/CircularLoom

### Winding Machines
JP Group offers a comprehensive range of winding machines for high-quality and efficient tape winding: Inverter/Electronic Tape Winder for precise speed and tension control, Auto Doffing Tape Winder for seamless automated roll changing, and the Jumbo Winder for high-capacity fibrillated tape winding (ideal for agriculture packaging, bale wrapping, rope manufacturing, and sewing yarn). Applications include woven & leno bags, FIBCs, tarpaulins, carpet backings, geotextiles, wrapping fabrics, ropes, and twines.
Page: https://jpel.in/WindingMachine

### Extrusion Coating Lines
JP Group's wide range of extrusion coating line models coats thin layers of polyolefins (mainly LDPE/PP) on substrates including paper, cotton cloth, woven fabrics, jute fabric, aluminum foil, BOPP film, and polyester film — up to 5200 mm web width. A tandem lamination plant is available for coating circular woven fabric and producing multilayer laminates up to 5 layers with various substrates such as paper, aluminum foil, and polyester film.
Page: https://jpel.in/ExtrusionCoating

### Flexographic Printing Machines
High-speed, PLC-based 4/6/8-colour flexographic printing machines for woven sacks, featuring inline corona treatment, micro perforation, twist gusseting, cutting/winding system, for HDPE/PP laminated and un-laminated woven fabrics. Each printing station has a specially designed micrometric adjustment system for fine pressure control between the anilox roll, printing drum, and fabric. Individual gearbox system with hardened, oil-dipped gears and inbuilt planetary arrangement reduces maintenance and downtime.
Page: https://jpel.in/PrintingMachine

### Bag Conversion Lines
JP Group's cutting-edge conversion lines produce bottom-folded and sewn woven sacks from tubular woven PP/HDPE fabric. The JPBCL-850 model is a high-speed, next-generation machine handling the entire process of cutting, bottom folding, sewing, and stacking woven fabric to produce durable, high-quality sacks.
Page: https://jpel.in/BagConversion

### Block Bottom Sack Conversion Lines (BBB)
The new generation AD VALVE™ pocket bag making machine, fully upgraded with new heat sealing technology, modular design, fewer fragile parts and maintenance projects. Features a patented new appearance design with support for a variety of AI visual detection solutions. Applications include cement & building materials, chemicals & minerals, animal feed & pet food, agricultural produce & seeds, and food & industrial powders.
Page: https://jpel.in/BBB

### Recycling Lines (PP/PE)
Recycling systems meticulously designed to wash and process PP/PE films and bags. Equipped with comprehensive cutting-edge equipment for thorough cleaning and effective recycling — transforming waste and heavily soiled PP/PE films and bags into high-quality recycled materials. Handles diverse contamination levels with advanced washing technologies, efficient drying, and filtration processes for minimal material loss and maximum recovery rates.
Page: https://jpel.in/WovenSack

### PET Washing Lines
Advanced recycling lines designed to efficiently reclaim valuable plastics from a wide range of waste materials, specializing in processing oriented HDPE/PP tapes, woven fabric cuttings, industrial plastic waste, and general-purpose plastics such as LDPE, LLDPE, HIPS, PP, and HDPE. Focused on sustainability and innovation.
Page: https://jpel.in/PET

### Battery Box Recycling Lines
Advanced solutions for recovering high-quality ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene) plastics from used and damaged car battery boxes. State-of-the-art recycling machines specifically engineered to efficiently process used battery boxes, ensuring maximum recovery of valuable materials.
Page: https://jpel.in/BatteryBox

### Monofilament Lines
Highly efficient monofilament line machines designed to produce HDPE, PP, and Nylon monofilaments with exceptional quality and performance. Crafted with advanced engineering for precision, durability, and efficiency. Applications include durable ropes & twines, toothbrush bristles, fishing nets, mosquito nets, and doll/wig hair.
Page: https://jpel.in/Monofilament

### PP/PET Box Strapping Lines
JP Group's PET Box Strap Line and PP Box Strap Line are designed with advanced technology for packaging and industrial applications. The PET Box Strap Line produces straps from 100% PET flakes or PET virgin granules, equipped with a Dehumidified Air Dryer and Crystallizer for optimal processing. Applications include packaging, logistics, construction, agriculture, and textiles.
Page: https://jpel.in/BoxStrapping

### Multilayer Sheet Lines
State-of-the-art monolayer and multilayer sheet extrusion lines for manufacturing HIPS (High Impact Polystyrene), ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene), PP (Polypropylene), PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate), and PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) sheets. Applications include thermoforming, vacuum forming, office files, luggage, office furniture, roofing, and other industries requiring high-quality plastic sheets.
Page: https://jpel.in/SheetExtrusion

### Multilayer Cast Film Lines
JP Group's Chill Roll Cast Film Lines produce high-quality multi-ply films (15–150 microns) that are indispensable in the packaging industry — including stretch films, cling films, barrier films, masking films, CPP films, and blister films.
Page: https://jpel.in/CastLine

### Flexible Packaging Lines
Extrusion coating lines for flexible packaging, applying molten polymer layers onto substrates to create multi-layer laminates that enhance strength, durability, and barrier properties (protection against moisture, oxygen, and light). Coating materials: LDPE, LLDPE, PP, EVA, EAA, EVOH, NUCREL SERLYN. Substrates: BOPP, paper, aluminum foil, CPP, polyester, METPET.
Page: https://jpel.in/Flexible

## Services

### Spare Part Services
JP Group provides comprehensive solutions for spare parts related to all its machinery and equipment. Sufficient inventory of critical and routine maintenance spares and consumables is maintained to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime. Spare parts are both genuine and cost-effective, with quick delivery and expert technical support for part identification and installation.
Page: https://jpel.in/spare-part-services

### IoT Services — JP Nexus
JP Nexus is JP Extrusiontech's intelligent IoT platform offering real-time monitoring of machine performance, predictive insights, advanced analytics, and instant alerts and notifications. Features include real-time monitoring, advanced analytics on production efficiency, high-performance optimisation to reduce downtime, and remote visibility.
Page: https://jpel.in/iot-services

### After-Sales & OOS Support
- After-sales service and technical support
- Out-of-service (OOS) repair support
- Process consulting and installation assistance
